sources.title: Reduction of symplectic manifolds with symmetry
sources.qualified_use: Foundational regular-level symplectic reduction and quotient theory for Hamiltonian group actions.

sources.title: On some exceptional cases in the integrability of the three-body problem
sources.qualified_use: Published positive-mass planar, fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum, parabolic-Lagrange monodromy and normal-variational nonintegrability result.

sources.title: Application of the Morales-Ramis theorem to test the non-complete integrability of the planar three-body problem
sources.qualified_use: Independent Morales-Ramis proof of planar non-complete meromorphic integrability and permission to use the normal variational system.

sources.title: The N-Body Problem on Coadjoint Orbits
sources.qualified_use: Contextual independent description of translation and spatial rotational reduction and the planar stratum; not a nonintegrability theorem.
